meta.title: SickleGuard daily patient simulator parameters

confidence_scale.high: value read directly from a primary abstract or official source during this review
confidence_scale.medium: from a secondary summary of a primary source, or a well-established clinical convention; verify before publication
confidence_scale.low: expert placeholder, derived value, or citation from memory not verified online; tune or replace once real data arrive

conventions.effect_sizes: multiplicative on the daily VOC hazard (rate ratio / hazard ratio); apply OR as RR when baseline daily risk < 5%
conventions.units: Hb g/dL; WBC 10^9/L; retic %; LDH U/L; bilirubin mg/dL; CRP mg/L; ferritin ng/mL; HR bpm; RMSSD ms; SpO2 %; skin temp deg C deviation from personal baseline; sleep hours

meta.warning: Synthetic data from these parameters are for pipeline development only. Never report model performance on simulated data as clinical accuracy.

outcome_definition.note: Choose ONE label definition; event rates differ ~5-10x between them.

utilisation_voc.definition: Acute pain requiring ED / day-hospital / admission and parenteral analgesia (CSSCD definition: pain lasting >=2 h requiring physician contact)

fraction_of_days_crisis_no_utilisation.source: Smith WR et al. Ann Intern Med 2008;148:94-101 (PiSCES), PMID 18195334

patient_reported_crisis_day.note: PiSCES cohort = 232 US adults >=16y followed up to 6 months; a skewed, chronic-pain-heavy population

outcome_definition.prediction_target: P(utilisation VOC onset in days t+1..t+7 | data up to day t)

ghana_scd_patients_kumasi_registry.source: Paintsil V et al. Front Genet 2022;13:802355 (SPARCO Kumasi registry) https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC8908904/
ghana_scd_patients_kumasi_registry.note: Clinic registry; 50.3% from newborn screening cohort. Sbeta0 not reported separately (likely counted within SS).

ghana_newborn_north_tamale.source: ASH 2024 abstract, Tamale Teaching Hospital newborn screening https://ash.confex.com/ash/2024/webprogram/Paper205127.html
ghana_newborn_north_tamale.note: Conference abstract. HbCC is not sickle cell disease; exclude from SCD cohort.

ghana_newborn_kumasi_trait.source: Kumasi newborn screening programme report (2005), via search summary; see https://ugspace.ug.edu.gh/items/8c9e245c-1010-47f3-8f4a-9bc256069444

us_scd_patients.source: Approximation from CSSCD cohort composition and US newborn screening (Hassell KL, Am J Prev Med 2010;38:S512, PMID 20331952 gives totals only)

baseline_hb_g_dl.source: US SCA cohort mean 8.9 +/- 1.3 (many on hydroxyurea): Jordan LC et al. Neurology 2025, PMC12614261; untreated African HbSS typically ~7.5-8.5 (not verified for Ghana)

hbf_pct.source: Typical untreated HbSS range; Platt 1991 (low HbF -> more pain). Ghana-specific value not located

hbf_pct_on_hydroxyurea.source: Typical HU response; MSH reported HbF rise (exact values not verified) PMID 7715639

acs_rate_per_100py.source: Castro O et al. Blood 1994;84:643-9 (via abstract summary) https://dh.howard.edu/sicklecell_fac/257

avn_incidence_per_100py.source: Milner PF et al. NEJM 1991;325:1476 (via summary) https://pesquisa.bvsalud.org/portal/resource/e/mdl-1944426

baseline_hb_g_dl.source: PIVOT Ghana HbSC trial baseline (n=214): Segbefia CI et al. BJH 2024, PMID 39406687

ever_voc_fraction_ghana.source: PIVOT Ghana baseline (prior vaso-occlusive events 86%, hospitalisation 93%), PMID 39406687

between_patient_heterogeneity.model: Per-patient VOC rate = genotype_rate * age_multiplier * covariate_RRs * frailty; frailty ~ Gamma(shape=k, mean=1)

gamma_shape_k.source: Derived to reproduce Platt 1991 skew: 39% of HbSS with no episodes; 5.2% of patients (3-10 episodes/yr) account for 32.9% of all episodes (PMID 1710777). Calibrate k by simulation.

age_multiplier_voc_HbSS.source: Shape follows Platt 1991 (pain rate peaks in 3rd decade); band values not verified from full text

fraction_of_crisis_days_with_utilisation.source: Derived from PiSCES: 3.5% utilisation days / (12.7% + 3.5%) crisis days, PMID 18195334

fraction_utilisation_vocs_admitted_vs_ed.source: Placeholder; US ED VOC admission rates commonly ~50-70%

los_days_ghana_kumasi_paediatric.source: Oppong-Mensah YG et al. Health Sci Rep 2023 (Kumasi SPARCo paediatric hospitalisations), PMID 37670846 https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC10475768

los_days_us_mean.source: US mean SCD admission LOS cited in Ghana BMJ Open 2021 paper

hospitalisation_and_los.los_distribution: lognormal, fit to median and IQR above

recurrence_within_30d_after_voc.source: Ballas SK & Smith ED, Blood 1992;79:2154 (~50% of painful episodes followed by recurrence within 1 month), PMID 1562742

readmission_30d_age_18_30_us.source: Brousseau DC et al. JAMA 2010;303:1288 (citation from memory)

voc_duration_days.source: Placeholder consistent with LOS data above

rate_ratio.source: MSH: median 2.5 vs 4.5 crises/yr (HU vs placebo), Charache S et al. NEJM 1995;332:1317, PMID 7715639

acs_patients_ratio.source: MSH: ACS in 25 vs 51 patients, PMID 7715639

onset_lag_days.source: MSH: benefits not manifest for several months, PMID 7715639

adherence_fraction_ghana.source: Placeholder; no Ghana adherence data located

hbf_per_1pct_increase.source: Direction: Platt 1991 (low HbF -> high pain rate; 'small increments may ameliorate'), PMID 1710777; magnitude not verified

baseline_wbc_per_1e9_increase.source: Direction: leukocytosis RR 1.80 for adverse outcome (Miller 2000, PMID 10631276); WBC >15 mortality risk (Platt 1994, PMID 7993409); VOC-specific magnitude not verified

baseline_hb_per_1g_dl_increase_HbSS.source: Direction: high haematocrit -> higher pain rate (Platt 1991, PMID 1710777); higher Hb -> more ACS (Castro 1994); magnitude not verified

prior_year_voc_count.source: Placeholder; prior utilisation is the strongest predictor in most SCD models. Consider implementing via frailty instead to avoid double counting

recent_voc_within_30d.source: Derived from Ballas 1992 ~50% 1-month recurrence (PMID 1562742) versus a baseline monthly risk of ~5-10%

high_vs_low_wind_category.source: Nolan VG et al. Br J Haematol 2008 case-crossover, PMID 18729854 https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC4347894

low_humidity.source: Direction: Jones S et al. Br J Haematol 2005;131:530 (London) https://eprints.kingston.ac.uk/7102/ ; magnitude placeholder

cold_low_max_temp_per_5C_drop.source: Direction: Northern Italy study (low max temp, low humidity, low pressure) and US national sample; London 2005 found no temperature effect. Magnitude placeholder. Ghana: harmattan (Dec-Feb, dry dusty wind, cool nights) is the relevant season

rainfall_per_1sd.source: Haematologica London/Paris study reported a similar RR for rainfall (summary)

dehydration_low_fluid_intake.source: Widely cited trigger (NHLBI 2014 Expert Panel); no quantified RR located

infection_fever.source: Recognised precipitant (fever, malaria in Ghana); no quantified RR located

malaria_episode_ghana.source: Placeholder; PIVOT Ghana: 79% had prior malaria (PMID 39406687)

fraction_women_susceptible.source: Vanderbilt survey of 103 women with SCD (via news report) https://sicklecellanemianews.com/news/vaso-occlusive-pain-linked-menstruation/

menstruation_perimenstrual.window: days -7..+5 around menses onset; 55% of reported episodes fell in the 7 days before menses, 38% during

psychological_stress_high_day.source: Direction: daily stress and mood predict same/next-day pain (Gil KM et al. Health Psychol 2004, citation from memory)

short_sleep_lt6h.source: Direction: poor sleep -> next-day pain (Valrie CR et al. daily diaries, citation from memory); nocturnal hypoxaemia -> more crises (Hargrave 2003, PMID 12393400)

alcohol_heavy_day.source: Patient-reported trigger; no quantified RR located

altitude_or_flight.source: Case series / guidance only; no quantified RR located

strenuous_exertion.source: Recognised trigger, especially with heat and dehydration; no quantified RR located

low_nocturnal_spo2_trait.source: Direction and significance: Hargrave 2003 Blood (p<0.0001), PMID 12393400; magnitude placeholder

pre_crisis_trajectories.note: Offsets relative to VOC onset day 0 (first utilisation/crisis day). Apply as additive (abs) or multiplicative (pct) deviations from the patient's personal baseline, plus noise. Evidence for >1-day consumer-wearable prodrome is weak; make lead strength a tunable 'signal_strength' parameter (0 = no prodrome) for robustness tests.

pain_0_10.source: Ballas 1992 phase 1 (pain escalation; RBC changes 1-3 d before pain), PMID 1562742; magnitudes placeholder

resting_hr_bpm.source: Direction: Duke Apple Watch (resting HR 2nd most important pain feature), PMC10634543; magnitudes placeholder

hrv_rmssd.source: Direction: USC Biostrap pilot (lower HF power preceded next-day higher pain, p=0.0002) https://ash.confex.com/ash/2023/webprogram/Paper187353.html ; VOC associated with HRV decline (Mizrahi 2026, PMID 42644133); magnitudes placeholder

spo2_pct.source: ACS defined with hypoxaemia; uncomplicated VOC small change (placeholder)

steps.source: Direction: step count top feature in Duke model, PMC10634543; magnitudes placeholder

fluid_intake_l.note: only when dehydration is the trigger

hb_g_dl.source: Direction: Hb decreases in phase 1 (Ballas 1992, PMID 1562742); ACS Hb fall ~0.7-0.8 g/dL (Vichinsky NEJM 2000, citation from memory)

reticulocytes_pct.source: Direction: reticulocytes rise during initial phase (Ballas 1992, PMID 1562742); magnitude placeholder

wearable_baselines_scd.note: Personal baseline drawn per patient from population distribution; daily value = baseline + circadian/weekly effects + AR(1) noise (phi ~0.5) + event deviations. Device missingness ~15-30% days (placeholder).

resting_hr_bpm.source: Placeholder: higher than non-anaemic peers due to compensatory high cardiac output; no SCD wearable norms found

hrv_rmssd_ms.source: Direction: SCD has lower HRV than controls (Mizrahi 2026 PMID 42644133; Lopez-Galan 2023 PMC10303389); magnitudes placeholder

spo2_pct_awake.source: Jordan LC et al. Neurology 2025 (SCA n=126; controls median 98) PMC12614261

spo2_pct_nocturnal_mean.source: Placeholder; nocturnal desaturation common in SCD children (Hargrave 2003, PMID 12393400)

pulse_oximeter_bias_dark_skin.source: Known occult hypoxaemia bias in darker skin; magnitude placeholder

skin_temp_nightly_deviation_c.source: Placeholder (wearable convention: deviation from personal baseline)

fluid_intake_l_per_day.source: Placeholder; higher intake routinely advised in SCD

daily_pain_0_10_steady_state.source: PiSCES: pain on 54.5% of days (PMID 18195334); intensity placeholder

labs.note: reference = healthy adult range; scd_ss / scd_sc = typical steady-state values. Steady state = no acute event for >=2-4 weeks.

hb_g_dl.source: Standard reference; SS: Jordan 2025 PMC12614261; SC: PIVOT PMID 39406687

wbc_1e9_l.source: Standard; SS leukocytosis well established (Platt 1994 threshold 15); Korle Bu: WBC higher in SS/SC than AA (Antwi-Boasiako 2018 doi:10.2147/JBM.S169872); exact means not verified

reticulocytes_pct.source: Typical clinical values; not verified from a single source

ferritin_ng_ml.source: Typical; rises with transfusion burden and inflammation

platelets_1e9_l.source: Typical; Korle Bu: platelets higher in SS/SC than AA (Antwi-Boasiako 2018)

steady_state_cbc_retic_days.source: Routine clinic review every 3-6 months (NHLBI 2014 Expert Panel convention); Ghana clinic practice not verified

on_hydroxyurea_titration_cbc_days.source: NHLBI 2014 Expert Panel: CBC ~every 4 weeks during dose escalation, then every 2-3 months

testing_cadence.during_admission: CBC, retic, LDH, CRP daily to every 2 days (placeholder, low)

thresholds_cm_s_tamm.source: STOP: Adams RJ et al. NEJM 1998;339:5, PMID 9647873

prevalence_abnormal_HbSS_children.source: Placeholder (~8-10% in pre-STOP US screening; Nigeria lower)

prevalence_abnormal_HbSC.source: Placeholder; abnormal TCD rare in HbSC

cumulative_HbSS.source: Frontiers in Neurology 2022 review citing DeBaun/Bernaudin cohorts https://www.frontiersin.org/articles/10.3389/fneur.2022.867329

adult_prevalence_median_age_24.source: Jordan LC et al. JAHA 2024, PMC11255756

ever_acs_fraction_csscd_followup.source: Derived: 1,085 of 3,751 patients had >=1 ACS during CSSCD follow-up (Castro 1994 summary)

avn.risk_factor: frequent painful crises -> higher AVN risk (Milner 1991)

HbSS_young_children.source: Placeholder; African HbSS children often retain splenomegaly

population_2021.source: Ghana Statistical Service 2021 PHC (final, sum of regions) via https://www.citypopulation.de/en/ghana/admin/ ; provisional 30,792,608

official_estimate.source: GNA June 2026 https://gna.org.gh/2026/06/ghana-struggles-to-achieve-nationwide-newborn-screening-for-sickle-cell/ ; Ghanaian Times 2025 (15,000-20,000, ~2% of births)

hardy_weinberg_check.source: Derived from Kumasi trait frequencies (AS 13.3%, AC 8.5%): SS+SC ~1.0% of 896,000 births

scd_births_per_year.note: Sources conflict ~3x. Dashboard should show a range and name the source.

scd_birth_prevalence.source: Widely quoted 2% of births (Ghanaian Times 2025); Kumasi trait-derived HW estimate ~1.0%

hydroxyurea.availability: Novartis public-private partnership; available from Nov 2019; Ghana FDA approved 2018
hydroxyurea.nhis_listing: Announced June 2021 for severe SCD; implementation status 2023-2026 unverified

coverage_fraction_HbSS_on_hu.source: Placeholder; no national uptake data found

annual_total_cost_usd_ge3_voc_per_year.source: Marfo et al. BMC Health Serv Res 2023 (private insurer claims 2015-2021; 1 GHS = 0.11328 USD) https://bmchealthservres.biomedcentral.com/articles/10.1186/s12913-023-09984-6

cost.note: Insurer-paid tariffs understate true cost (out-of-pocket, lost work, carers).

regions.note: population = 2021 PHC. zone determines HbS/HbC allele frequencies (south: higher HbS; north: higher HbC; north-south intermarriage ~2.6%). Allele freqs are zone-level approximations, NOT regional measurements.

south_forest_coastal.source: Derived from Kumasi newborn trait rates (AS 13.3%, AC 8.5%)

north_savannah.source: Derived from Tamale newborn genotypes (ASH 2024 abstract)

far_north_upper.source: Ghansah A et al. PLoS One 2012 (Kassena-Nankana, Upper East; controls n=806), PMID 22506028 https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC3323552

regions.source: https://www.citypopulation.de/en/ghana/admin/ (GSS 2021 PHC); zone assignment is the author's judgement
regions.confidence: high for population; low for zone assignment

sample_size_guidance.method: Riley RD et al. BMJ 2020;368:m441 (pmsampsize): shrinkage >=0.9, optimism <=0.05, risk within +/-0.05

worked_example.note: Derived here; clustered data -> target >=200 events from >=150-200 distinct patients

external_validation_min_events.source: Collins GS, Ogundimu EO, Altman DG. Stat Med 2016 (citation from memory)
